excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交官僚机构中已经筛选出了一批有丑闻潜质的子个体。其中几个的潜在丑闻已经被我方发现，我们的特工正在竭尽全力，确保事情能朝我们希冀的方向发展。
excerpt.en: We have drawn up a list of potentially scandal-prone figures within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic bureaucracy. Several potential leads have been found, and our operatives are working hard to find the best means by which to manufacture the desired outcome
